answer: Like salt crystallization in a stagnant lagoon, genuine peer consensus deposits trust slowly layer upon layer. Sybil swarms find that simulating authentic history is no fragile fable of cheap signatures; peer-bonded staking rules impose an exponential attacker cost with each duplicated identity. What appears as smooth velvet from afar reveals an unforgiving, superlinear lattice where rogue clones fracture under escalating verification stakes.
